titulo: Russian missiles and drone reportedly hit Poland during attacks on Ukraine
cuerpo: Polish PM calls strikes, which took place amid western military exercises, ‘an intentional provocation’ by Moscow Two Russian cruise missiles and a jet-powered drone are reported to have crashed in Poland during Russian air attacks on Ukraine that took place amid major western military exercises by allied countries. Ukraine’s president, Volodymyr Zelenskyy, said it was “one of the largest attacks” since the full-scale Russian invasion in 2022, with at least eight people killed and nearly 30 injured in Ukraine.
